title: Go
description: Go projects: the module proxy and checksum database, Go's downloads and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: Go
de.description: Go-Projekte: der Modul-Proxy und die Prüfsummen-Datenbank, Gos Downloads und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The toolchain: a release from go.dev/dl unpacked into the sandbox's HOME (kept with the start), or Debian's older golang in an image variant: sandbox-ai images new go --from claude, sandbox-ai images extend go --add-apt golang, sandbox-ai build --variant go, then --image-variant go. A newer toolchain a go.mod asks for comes from the module proxy.
Modules outside the proxy (private ones, GOPROXY=direct) need their host: --allow-host NAME on the command line.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
